dossier_refresh.kill_risk: The load-bearing claim is "an unfired, mechanically-due pivotal binary with defined downside". Both halves are attackable from the live record. (1) The price has already discounted the win: on my legs the breakeven probability is (20.17-2.50)/(30-2.50) = 64.3%, above my 62% fundamental estimate, so the expected value is roughly flat-to-slightly-negative rather than the +45% the board carries - the edge was in the $8-14 tape, not at a 52-week high. (3) The downside is not defined in any protective sense: the same management team's prior binary (AMX0035 PHOENIX) closed $18.97 on 7 Mar 2024 and $3.36 on 8 Mar 2024, -82% in one session, resting at $1.62 by June 2024 - and that shell held more cash per share than AMLX will hold at the LUCIDITY print, so $2.50 is a mark, not a floor; $1.60-2.00 is inside precedent. (4) Timing residual: "Q3 2026" is a company-guided quarter window, not a PDUFA-style binding date, and slip into Q4 is possible - the 6 August 2026 Q2 call is the next checkpoint that would confirm or break the September end-stop.
